Change c0466. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. VI; 1831 Ch. XXIII.

Context before (unchanged): I know not; I lost sensation, and chains and darkness were the only objects that pressed upon me.

1818 text: Sometimes, indeed, I dreamt that I wandered in flowery meadows and pleasant vales with the friends of my youth; but awoke, and found myself in a dungeon.

1831 text: Sometimes, indeed, I dreamt that I wandered in flowery meadows and pleasant vales with the friends of my youth; but I awoke, and found myself in a dungeon.

Diff: Sometimes, indeed, I dreamt that I wandered in flowery meadows and pleasant vales with the friends of my youth; but {+I+} awoke, and found myself in a dungeon.

Context after (unchanged): Melancholy followed, but by degrees I gained a clear conception of my miseries and situation, and was then released from my prison.

result.rationale: Only the insertion of the pronoun "I" before "awoke" changes; the sentence's meaning and syntax are unaffected, a minor grammatical smoothing with no interpretive consequence.
